risks.title: Data lifetime conflicts with user expectations
risks.description: The BRD requires database persistence while the invocation mandates in-memory SQLite; restart durability is undefined.
risks.mitigation: Answer Q-001 and make restart/reset behavior explicit in tests and user-facing documentation.
risks.owner_or_decision: Human product/technical owner via Q-001 and ADR-001

risks.title: Privilege escalation through undefined role assignment
risks.description: Public sign-up could allow selection of Manager or Admin unless role assignment is defined.
risks.mitigation: Approve role provisioning and enforce server-side assignment with negative tests.
risks.owner_or_decision: Human security/product owner via Q-002 and ADR-002

risks.title: Cross-user data exposure
risks.description: Record ownership, manager oversight, and admin edit powers are not defined.
risks.mitigation: Approve a role/ownership matrix and test every endpoint and download against it.
risks.owner_or_decision: Human product/security owner via Q-003 and Q-004

risks.title: Inconsistent or untestable validation
risks.description: Most required fields, enum values, lengths, date rules, and tags are unspecified.
risks.mitigation: Approve field-level validation tables before generation.
risks.owner_or_decision: Human product owner via Q-005 and Q-007

risks.title: Weak or incompatible authentication implementation
risks.description: Session mechanism, password rules, expiration, logout, and failed-login behavior are unspecified.
risks.mitigation: Approve a simple authentication contract and required security acceptance tests.
risks.owner_or_decision: Human security/technical owner via Q-010 and ADR-003

risks.title: Dashboard metrics do not match stakeholder meaning
risks.description: Scope, recent ordering/count, completion denominator, and open statuses are undefined.
risks.mitigation: Approve exact formulas and seeded examples before implementation.
risks.owner_or_decision: Human product owner via Q-008 and ADR-004

risks.title: Downloaded reports are incomplete, inconsistent, or leak data
risks.description: Report columns, ordering, date boundaries, formatting, and empty/failure behavior are unspecified.
risks.mitigation: Approve a report contract per format and reuse the authorization scope of on-screen data.
risks.owner_or_decision: Human product/security owner via Q-009 and ADR-005

risks.title: Responsive and recovery claims cannot be objectively evaluated
risks.description: No browser/viewport matrix or user-visible failure behavior is defined.
risks.mitigation: Approve Q-013 and convert it into a Playwright/failure test matrix.

risks.title: Extension scope causes uncontrolled feature growth
risks.description: The BRD requires two additional features but does not select them or define whether they belong in the current plan.
risks.mitigation: Select exactly two features, define exclusions, and revise E006 stories without renumbering.
risks.owner_or_decision: Human product owner via Q-012 and ADR-006
